# temps_funnel (Resource)

A conversion funnel of a project's analytics: the share of visitors who go through `steps` in order. Released Temps servers do not return a funnel's steps, so the provider does not read them: steps changed elsewhere are not detected.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `analytics:read`, `analytics:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_funnel" "signup" {
  project_id  = temps_project.web.id
  name        = "Signup"
  description = "Landing page to completed signup"
  steps = jsonencode([
    { event_name = "page_view", event_filter = [] },
    { event_name = "signup_completed", event_filter = [] },
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the funnel.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `steps` (String) Steps in order: `jsonencode([{ event_name = "page_view", event_filter = [] }, { event_name = "signup" }])`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the funnel measures.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the funnel is computed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_funnel.signup 8/4
```
